description: This file defines an abstract class 'BaseLLM' implementing the 'ILLM' interface, providing core functionalities for language model interactions such as streaming completions, chat handling, reranking, and token counting. It manages API interactions, logging, and message formatting for language models within a larger project.

classes.name: BaseLLM
classes.description: An abstract class providing core methods and properties for language model implementations, including streaming, chat, reranking, token counting, and API interaction management.

methods.name: supportsFim
methods.description: Returns false, indicating this base class does not support FIM (Few-shot In-context Learning).

methods.name: supportsCompletions
methods.description: Determines if the provider supports text completions based on provider name and API base.

methods.name: streamFim
methods.description: Abstract method to stream FIM responses; not implemented in base class.

methods.name: streamComplete
methods.description: Abstract method to stream completion responses; not implemented in base class.

methods.name: streamChat
methods.description: Streams chat message responses; can be overridden or used as is.

methods.name: rerank
methods.description: Re-ranks chunks based on a query using the provider's rerank API if supported.

methods.name: _streamComplete
methods.description: Abstract generator for streaming completion; must be implemented in subclasses.

methods.name: _streamChat
methods.description: Streams chat messages; requires implementation or override.

methods.name: _complete
methods.description: Completes a prompt by aggregating streamed chunks.

methods.name: countTokens
methods.description: Counts tokens in a given text using the model's tokenization.
